name: Advanced packaging & substrate

tables.title: Vendor momentum (FY2026)
rows: Packaging capacity 'so tight that now it's LIMITING MY CUSTOMERS' GROWTH'; CoWoS still the majority; glass-substrate pilot line ~1 more year to maturity; +$100bn Arizona includes adv-packaging fabs

TWO LANDMARK AGREEMENTS: a 10-YEAR advanced packaging agreement with TSMC (US/Arizona framework to expand packaging + test capacity) and a MULTI-YEAR NVIDIA partnership for next-gen AI infrastructure, structured as a $1.5B prepayment received in 2027 and worked off as US services are delivered (5-10 yr term). Arizona Phase I now FULLY COMMITTED. Record Q2 $1.898B (+26% YoY), GM 16.8% -> guided 18.5-19.5% in Q3 on compute mix; 2.5D 11 customers / HDFO 5 customers, 10 engagements; capex $2.5-3.0B; underutilized Arizona a GM+OM drag in 2028

Record ATM rev NTD 126.1bn (+36% YoY), ATM GM 27.3% -> Q4 to EXCEED the 30% structural ceiling (range to be revised UP from 26-29%). LEAP 2026 ~$3.7bn (+$200M vs guide) and aiming to DOUBLE in 2027; general segment now +30% (was 13%). Capex raised $2bn to ~$10.5bn ($6.5bn equipment / $4bn facilities; 70% of equipment = leading edge); 13 greenfield + 8 brownfield projects. Capacity, not demand, is the gate — utilization 80-85% but effectively full

packaging revenue raised to +>70% CY2026 (from +50%); panel revenue 'pretty significant growth' in 2027 then ramps; hybrid bonding meaningful driver; Broadcom joined EPIC for AI packaging; new Nokota VMax plating / Opta Quad CMP / 2 e-beam packaging systems
Q1 rev +35% / OP +41%; order backlog KRW 573.7B (~1.7x qtr rev); one customer = 42.2% of sales; Plant 5 expansion staged — big-tech IN-HOUSE AI ASICs driving ultra-multilayer MLB demand
Memory-substrate cycle TURN: Q1 rev +37% YoY and FIRST operating profit of the cycle (+KRW 0.96B vs -36.8B a year ago; FY2025 was loss-making)
Q1 OP KRW 51.3B EXCEEDED all of FY2025 (49.1B); export ASP +29% on high-end mix; substrate capex extended to 2027 + new building expansion disclosed 05-11-2026
